name: io.github.tonyyang0504/zalora-mcp
description: Zalora (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALORA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application ID of an OAuth application created in ZALORA Seller Center (Settings > Integration Management > OAuth Applications > Add Application).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALORA_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Application Secret of the same application; sent with the id as HTTP Basic to /oauth/client-credentials (grant_type=client_credentials) for a 1-hour bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALORA_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Country code of the price row that update_listing / end_listing change (Seller Center country code of the venture, as used in PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country}).
